papers.title: Solving forward and inverse PDE problems on unknown manifolds via physics-informed neural operators
papers.abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the effectiveness of deep operator networks (DeepONets) in solving both forward and inverse problems of partial differential equations (PDEs) on unknown manifolds. By unknown manifolds, we identify the manifold by a set of randomly sampled data point clouds that are assumed to lie on or close to the manifold. When the loss function incorporates the physics, resulting in the so-called physics-informed DeepONets (PI-DeepONets), we approximate the differentiation terms in the PDE by an appropriate operator approximation scheme. For the second-order elliptic PDE with a nontrivial diffusion coefficient, we approximate the differentiation term with one of these methods: the Diffusion Maps (DM), the Radial Basis Functions (RBF), and the Generalized Moving Least Squares (GMLS) methods. For the GMLS approximation, which is more flexible for problems with boundary conditions, we derive the theoretical error bound induced by the approximate differentiation. Numerically, we found that DeepONet is accurate for various types of diffusion coefficients, including linear, exponential, piecewise linear, and quadratic functions, for linear and semi-linear PDEs with/without boundaries. When the number of observations is small, PI-DeepONet trained with sufficiently large samples of PDE constraints produces more accurate approximations than DeepONet. For the inverse problem, we incorporate PI-DeepONet in a Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) framework to estimate the diffusion coefficient from noisy solutions of the PDEs measured at a finite number of point cloud data. Numerically, we found that PI-DeepONet provides accurate approximations comparable to those obtained by a more expensive method that directly solves the PDE on the proposed diffusion coefficient in each MCMC iteration.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建，但缺乏约束处理与植入物特定验证。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not validate on finite element method simulations or implant biomechanics, nor does it address constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 在未知流形上高效求解PDE正反问题。
summary_zh.method: 结合扩散映射等微分近似与物理信息DeepONet框架。
summary_zh.result: 多种扩散系数下均准确，小样本时优于标准DeepONet。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值PDE基准上验证，含贝叶斯反演。

summary_en.motivation: To solve forward and inverse PDE problems on unknown manifolds using limited point cloud data.
summary_en.method: Physics-informed DeepONets with operator approximation schemes (Diffusion Maps, Radial Basis Functions, Generalized Moving Least Squares) for differential terms.
summary_en.result: PI-DeepONet achieves accurate approximations for various diffusion coefficients and outperforms standard DeepONet when data is scarce, while also enabling Bayesian inference for inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on linear and semi-linear elliptic PDEs with differing diffusion coefficients and boundary conditions.

papers.title: VideoCoT: A Video Chain-of-Thought Dataset with Active Annotation Tool
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are flourishing, but mainly focus on images with less attention than videos, especially in sub-fields such as prompt engineering, video chain-of-thought (CoT), and instruction tuning on videos. Therefore, we try to explore the collection of CoT datasets in videos to lead to video OpenQA and improve the reasoning ability of MLLMs. Unfortunately, making such video CoT datasets is not an easy task. Given that human annotation is too cumbersome and expensive, while machine-generated is not reliable due to the hallucination issue, we develop an automatic annotation tool that combines machine and human experts, under the active learning paradigm. Active learning is an interactive strategy between the model and human experts, in this way, the workload of human labeling can be reduced and the quality of the dataset can be guaranteed. With the help of the automatic annotation tool, we strive to contribute three datasets, namely VideoCoT, TopicQA, TopicCoT. Furthermore, we propose a simple but effective benchmark based on the collected datasets, which exploits CoT to maximize the complex reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness our solution.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文讨论视频链式推理数据集和标注工具，与FEA代理模型和生物力学设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on video chain-of-thought reasoning for multimodal language models, with no mention of finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 视频链式推理数据集稀缺且人工标注成本高
summary_zh.method: 提出结合机器与人类专家的主动学习标注工具
summary_zh.result: 构建了三个视频推理数据集并验证了有效性
summary_zh.validation: 基于数据集的基准测试实验

summary_en.motivation: High cost and difficulty of creating video chain-of-thought datasets motivate an efficient annotation approach.
summary_en.method: An automatic annotation tool combining machine and human experts under an active learning paradigm is developed.
summary_en.result: Three video reasoning datasets are constructed and a benchmark demonstrates improved reasoning capability of multimodal LLMs.
summary_en.validation: Extensive experiments on the proposed benchmark validate the effectiveness of the annotation tool and datasets.

papers.title: Retrospective: Advances and Opportunities of 3D Bioprinting in China over Three Decades
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting, which has been applied in tissue engineering and regenerative medicine, uses biomaterials, cells, and other essential components to manufacture organs and tissues with specific biological functions and complex structures. Over the past 30 years, researchers have developed new 3D bioprinting technologies with improved manufacturing capabilities and expanded applications. Chinese research teams contributed significantly to this process. In this paper, we first reviewed the development history and major milestones in 3D bioprinting, categorizing them into two main strategies: "biomaterial-based indirect assembly" and "living cell-based direct assembly". This review further delved into the technical principles, recent advancements, advantages, disadvantages, and applications of each type of bioprinting technology. Finally, the challenges and future directions of 3D bioprinting were summarized to guide future research in China and foster advancements in this dynamic field.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇综述概括了中国三维生物打印的发展历史和技术分类，但完全没有涉及人工智能在生物打印中的应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a general review of 3D bioprinting technologies and history, with no integration of AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage.

summary_zh.motivation: 总结中国30年3D生物打印的发展与未来方向
summary_zh.method: 文献综述，按间接组装和直接组装两大类技术进行梳理
summary_zh.result: 归纳了各类生物打印技术的原理、优缺点及应用
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述

summary_en.motivation: To provide a comprehensive review of 3D bioprinting development in China over three decades and identify future directions.
summary_en.method: A literature review categorizing bioprinting technologies into biomaterial-based indirect assembly and living cell-based direct assembly.
summary_en.result: Summarized the principles, advantages, disadvantages, and applications of each bioprinting technology type.
summary_en.validation: This is a review paper; no experimental validation was performed.
